dedupe_keys.name: opentextile nir textile hyperspectral images photographs and spectra

description: OpenTextile-NIR contains near-infrared hyperspectral images and RGB photographs of seventy-one textile samples collected in Finland. VTT researchers examined mainly used workwear from post-industrial sources, providing sample composition metadata, representative spectra and colour values. Zenodo distributes image archives, CSV summaries and an example Python reader free under CC BY 4.0. The hyperspectral archive alone is about 10.8 gigabytes. Geographic coverage is the supplied Finnish sample collection, with calendar acquisition dates not established. The provider identifies three samples with unknown composition and eleven suspected composition outliers, which are limitations for treating supplier labels as definitive ground truth. Millions of pixel spectra remain nested within a small number of garments. Modellers could calibrate optical material identification or sorting uncertainty in textile-recycling simulations. platform-siemens-plant-simulation is a related production-flow environment requiring a separate recognition component. No image archive, individual spectrum or code file was downloaded, and no classifier was evaluated.
